title: Average Cost for Three Bit Majority
statement: Every zero-error randomized decision tree computing majority on three signs, with each input coordinate sampled independently and uniformly from $\\{-1,1\\}$, has average query cost at least $5/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The randomized decision tree has a finite nonempty seed space with a seed distribution
Every seed selects a deterministic tree computing three-sign majority
The three input signs are sampled independently and uniformly
